mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a waxing gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will drop to 50 degrees, with no rain in the forecast.

City officials have announced that crack filling maintenance begins on September 28. Work will take place across several areas including Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street, so please use caution in those work zones.

We have plenty to do in town. Yoga at Insight Wellness is scheduled for today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and don't forget the Verona Fall Fest coming up on September 25.
On September 5, officers noted an unusual incident involving the Dairy Dare, where several vehicles were discovered with cheese slices on their windshields throughout the city.

Culver's of Verona is currently undergoing a remodel and will be closed for the day, but they are set to resume normal operations soon. Make sure to head over before they close for the night at 10:00 PM.
